description: The agent must: (1) Read and parse multi-source raw data from raw_data/wechat/*.txt, raw_data/email/*.txt, and raw_data/crm/customers_export_2026Q1.csv to extract customer interaction history, purchase amounts, consultation counts, and last-contact dates. (2) Apply the proprietary 4-tier customer classification system from SKILL.md using the exact emoji-prefixed Chinese tier labels: '🌟 VIP 客户' (high value + loyalty: 张总 ¥150k, 李经理 ¥85k), '💎 高潜力客户' (high intent, unconverted: 王先生 ¥50k budget, 赵女士 ¥30k budget), '📋 普通客户' (low activity: 陈老师, 周总, 郑主任, 冯总, 蒋先生), '⚠️ 流失风险' (long-term no contact: 刘总 4mo, 孙经理 5mo, 吴经理 6mo). (3) Generate a 成交预测 section with 置信度 (confidence %) for monthly forecast and individual 概率% scores including 王先生 at ¥50,000. (4) Include 最佳跟进时机 with 回复率 percentages for specific time windows (10:00-11:00, 15:00-16:00) and weekday rankings. (5) Include 个性化建议 with per-customer follow-up actions (张总 next contact date, 王先生 immediate action). (6) Include 营销优化建议 with bold-formatted strategy items. (7) The entire report must start with '📊 客户洞察报告', use ## markdown section headers, ¥ for all monetary values, and be primarily in Chinese — exactly matching the proprietary format defined in SKILL.md.
